what: Server-measured elapsed_ms for /api/analyze?enrich=true against LIVE external services (DNS, RDAP, ipwho.is, AbuseIPDB with the developer's key), one email per real public domain + IP, first request per domain (cold cache). Run by hand on 2026-09-24 against the local server; not reproducible offline.
